name: A Rolling Success
jem_summary: Make a decorated cake, a cupcake and a cookie on a Caking Station.

pages.title: A Rolling Success
pages.text: Make a decorated cake, a cupcake and a cookie on a Caking Station.

pages.title: A Rolling Success
pages.text: Control manual baking and different serving forms.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Put Cake Dough on the station and add its topping. A knife cuts cupcake portions; a rolling pin opens the cookie branch. One completed product of each is enough.

pages.title: Start a blank cake
pages.text: Place Cake Dough directly on a Caking Station. This begins a manual process rather than an ordinary finished-cake crafting recipe.

pages.title: Decorate a cake
pages.text: Jam or chocolate spread finishes the cake base directly on the work surface.

pages.title: Cut cupcakes
pages.text: A Bread Knife cuts the unfinished base into smaller portions; supported toppings complete the cupcakes.

pages.title: Roll cookies
pages.text: A Rolling Pin flattens the prepared portions, then glazing finishes the separate cookie branch.

pages.title: Arrange bakery displays
pages.text: A Tray uses individual positions. A Wall Display accepts food and bread, while a Cupcake Display allows more flexible decoration.
